schema_note: Each entry follows docs/mvp/templates/skill-authoring/trigger-queries.json at c17e758417da64928a0f47fc2600304465ac3f3c (id, query, should_trigger, split) plus a category field and, for negatives, an owner field naming the sibling skill that should be selected instead. Tier A only: these observe whether the terminal consults this skill for a request that does not name it. No entry supplies the skill path or name except the explicit_invocation category, which is recorded separately and is never counted as implicit activation evidence.
split_policy: Fixed and stratified by should_trigger and by category, assigned once at authoring time and recorded here. It is not re-randomized per run. Validation entries and their should_trigger values must not be placed in an author-loop or task-worker context; only the train split may drive any description iteration. Repair pass 1 moved A3e to train because its wording overlaps SKILL.md's opening paragraph, and added A3h as a fresh validation probe; the stratification by should_trigger and category is unchanged.
execution_status: NOT_RUN. No query below has been issued to any terminal. Discovery and activation for this package are NOT_OBSERVED.
negative_note: The owner field records which skill should handle the request instead. Several of those skills are specified and not implemented, which does not weaken the negative: the requirement is that this skill is not consulted, and non-activation is observable independently of whether a routing target exists. Do not install a stub to obtain a routing result.
